subject: dino_bones_paleontologist_3 discovering a small tooth in matrix

visual_logic.composition: Medium close-up. Paleontologist_3 (curly black hair, white sun hat) is hunched over a wooden sifting screen resting over a bucket.
visual_logic.action: He has just spotted the tiny, leaf-shaped tooth among a pile of grey river pebbles and mudstone. He is using a pair of stainless steel tweezers to carefully lift the 'grinder' tooth out of the sifter. A magnifying loupe is hanging around his neck.
visual_logic.details: The dappled light of the Two Medicine woodland hits the wet pebbles in the tray, making the fossil tooth stand out. His purple tee shows a few damp mud splatters from the work.
visual_logic.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; emphasize the 'treasure hunt' aspect of finding small teeth.
